svg.title: Nibras LegalTech architecture
svg.desc: A multi-tenant core holding up four pillars. Identity: Authentication, Authorization, Granular RBAC, Plan-aware access. Legal Domain: Cases, Clients, Documents, Tasks, Workflows. Intelligence: OCR, Retrieval, Vector search, RAG, AI-assisted workflows. Infrastructure: Docker, PostgreSQL, Nginx, Background jobs, Production deployment. Built on Asp.Net Core 8, C#, Ef Core, React, Typescript, Postgresql, Pgvector Signalr, Hangfire, Jwt, Docker, Linux, Nginx.
svg.text: ASP.NET CORE 8 · C# · EF CORE · REACT · TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · PGVECTOR
